**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Sparkling:

- **§ 3 (Restrictions on Use)**, including 3(g) on Page 2, is confined to ordinary licence-scope limits — copying, documentation, assignment/sublicence, reverse engineering, use of the Work as authorised, and service-bureau use. Nothing restricts what businesses we operate or what routing products we may buy or build.
- **§ 19** is a mutual employee non-solicitation (term plus one year), not a non-compete, so it falls outside this rule.
- **§ 14 (Confidentiality)** imposes no residual bar on developing competing software and expressly carves out independently developed information.
- Targeted searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "similar software", "business of" and "shall not develop" surfaced only the non-exclusive licence grants and jurisdiction wording — no restrictive covenant binding us.

Preferred playbook position is satisfied; the fallback (narrowed, term-only restriction) is not needed.
